questions.question:
A: I was _____(A)_____ seeing a movie tonight with my girlfriend, but she _____(B)_____ me.
B: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that. Are you still going to see the movie?
A: No, I'm going to _____(C)_____ that. I'm not in the mood to see a movie right now.

(A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 표현으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) looking forward to는 '~을 기대하다'는 의미로 문맥에 맞음. (B) broke up with는 '~와 헤어지다'는 의미인데, '그녀가 나를 버렸다'는 문맥에 맞음. (C) hold off는 '~을 미루다/연기하다'는 의미로 '그 영화 보는 것을 미루겠다'는 문맥에 맞음.

questions.question: 다음 대화 중 가장 자연스럽지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④번이 가장 자연스럽지 않음. A가 '너는 뭘 할 건데?'라고 물었는데 B가 '나는 잘 지냈어'라고 대답하는 것은 문맥상 맞지 않음. A의 질문에 대한 직접적인 대답이 없음.

options: ①Instead, we took a good idea and improved on it.
②One student said we needed a strong base.
③Another student suggested a triangle shape for the base.
④All of us agreed and divided up the roles such as time checker and tape cutter.
⑤The free rider problem occurred and the team was split.
questions.question:
다음 글의 문맥상 어색한 문장은?

We're one team.
We didn't try to choose the best idea. Instead, we took a good idea and improved on it. One student said we needed a strong base. Another student suggested a triangle shape for the base. All of us agreed and divided up the roles such as time checker and tape cutter. The free rider problem occurred and the team was split. As a result, we built our tall tower as a team!

*free rider 무임승차자
questions.explanation: ⑤번이 문맥상 어색함. 앞의 문장들은 모두 팀이 함께 협력한 긍정적인 내용인데, '무임승차 문제가 발생했고 팀이 갈라졌다'는 것은 부정적인 내용으로 문맥에 맞지 않음. '결과적으로 우리는 팀으로서 높은 탑을 만들었다'는 긍정적인 결론과 모순됨.

options: All materials have to be used.
The tower must stand up without any support.
The Marshmallow Challenge is an individual activity.
The team with the most creative tower wins the challenge.
The Marshmallow Challenge is helpful for practicing construction.
questions.question:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 고르시오.

Try the Marshmallow Challenge!
You need:
20 stick of spaghetti 1 marshmallow
1 meter of tape 1 meter of string
Rules:
- Each team has four people.
- You have to build the tallest tower in your class.
- The marshmallow must be on top.
- The tower must stand by itself.
- The time limit is 15 minutes.
This activity is good for:
- Building Relationships - Solving Problems
- Thinking Creatively
questions.explanation: ①번은 글에서 확인할 수 없음. ②번은 'The tower must stand by itself'라고 명시되어 있어 맞음. ③번은 'Each team has four people'이라고 했으므로 단체 활동이며 틀림. ④번은 글에서 '가장 창의적인 탑을 가진 팀이 우승한다'고 하지 않음. ⑤번은 '건설 연습'이라고 하지 않고 '관계 형성, 문제 해결, 창의적 사고'에 도움이 된다고 함.

options: ①
②
③
④
⑤
questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중 문맥상 어울리지 않는 것을 고르시오.

We didn't spend much time on ①planning. All the members started building the tower right away. Our first tower looked like a tent. It was a little ②small. We tried again. The next tower was tall but it couldn't stand by itself. After many tries, it was ③impossible for us to build a beautiful and tall tower. It seemed like the Leaning Tower of Pisa. We finally made the tower ④the we wanted!
questions.explanation: ④번이 문법적으로 어색함. 'the tower the we wanted'는 문법적으로 맞지 않음. 'the tower we wanted' 또는 'the tower that we wanted'가 되어야 함. 'the'가 불필요하게 중복됨.

options: Very good.
Pretty well.
Not so bad.
Not so good.
I've been fine.
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 적절한 표현은?

Mike: Amy, how have you been?
Amy: I've been great. How about you, Mike?
Mike: ___________________. I have a bad cold.
Amy: Oh, no! Get well soon.
Mike: Thanks.
questions.explanation: Mike가 'I have a bad cold'라고 했으므로, 앞의 표현은 부정적이어야 함. 'Not so good'이 '별로 좋지 않다'는 의미로 감기가 있는 상황과 맞음. ①②⑤는 긍정적인 표현이고, ③은 'Not so bad'로 약간 긍정적이므로 맞지 않음.

questions.question:
다음 대화의 흐름을 보아 빈칸에 (A)~(D)의 알맞은 순서는?

Minho: Linda! Is that you? Long time no see.
Linda: Minho! It's been a long time.
Minho: How have you been?
Linda: I've been good. How about you?
Minho: _______________________________________
Linda: _______________________________________
Minho: _______________________________________
Linda: _______________________________________
Minho: You still have my number, right?
Linda: Yeah, I'll call you later. Have a good day!
Minho: You, too. Bye!

(A) That's great! I'm happy to hear that.
(B) It's wonderful. I've made many new friends.
(C) Thanks. Oh! I have to go to my violin lesson now.
(D) I've been really busy at school. How's your new school?
questions.explanation: 대화의 자연스러운 흐름: Minho가 'I've been really busy at school. How's your new school?'(D)라고 하면, Linda가 'It's wonderful. I've made many new friends.'(B)라고 긍정적으로 대답. Minho가 'That's great! I'm happy to hear that.'(A)라고 응답. Linda가 'Thanks. Oh! I have to go to my violin lesson now.'(C)라고 시간이 없음을 알림. 순서: (D)-(B)-(A)-(C)

options: A new school year started on March 2nd.
Jinsu and Sora have been in the same class before.
Jinsu is going to participate in a piano competition.
Jinsu started playing the piano five years ago.
Sora wished Jinsu good luck in his school year.
questions.question:
다음 Sora의 일기 내용과 다른 것은?

Tuesday, March 2nd
Today was the first day of the school year. I met Jinsu after a long vacation. We are in the same class again. Jinsu said he has been pretty busy because of a piano competition next week. I didn't know he played the piano for 5 years. I wished him good luck.
questions.explanation: ⑤번이 일기 내용과 다름. 일기에서 Sora는 'I wished him good luck'이라고 했으므로 '피아노 경연대회에 행운을 빈다'는 의미이지, '학교 첫날에 행운을 빈다'는 의미가 아님. ①②③④번은 모두 일기 내용과 일치함.

questions.question:
다음 글의 흐름으로 보아 밑줄 친 (A)~(E)의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

We didn't try to choose the best idea to finish the marshmallow challenge. (A) Another student suggested a triangle shape for the base. (B) Finally, we built our own tower! (C) Instead, we took one good idea and made it better. (D) We all agreed and worked together as one team. (E) One student said we needed a strong base. Though the marshmallow challenge was not easy, it was fun.
questions.explanation: 논리적 흐름: '최고의 아이디어를 선택하지 않는 대신(C)', '좋은 아이디어를 더 좋게 만들었다(E) - 한 학생이 강한 밑받침이 필요하다고 했음(A) - 다른 학생이 삼각형 모양을 제안(D) - 모두가 동의하고 함께 일함(B) - 최종적으로 우리 탑을 만들었다.' 순서: (C)-(E)-(A)-(D)-(B)

questions.question:

We're one team.
We didn't try to choose the best idea. Instead, we took a good idea and improved on it. One student said we needed a strong base. Another student suggested a triangle shape for the base. questions.explanation: ①'Why did they divide the roles?' - 글에서 역할을 나눴다는 내용이 있지만 이유는 명시되지 않음. ②'What kind of roles did they have?' - time checker, tape cutter라고 명시됨. ③'Did they succeed?' - 'we built our tall tower'라고 명시됨. ④'Which shape is the lowest part?' - 'triangle shape for the base'라고 명시됨. ⑤'What did they do instead?' - 'we took a good idea and improved on it'라고 명시됨. ①번이 답을 찾을 수 없음.

questions.question:

Team C
We didn't try to choose the best idea. Instead, we took a good idea and improved on it. One student said we needed a strong base. Another student suggested a triangle shape for the base. questions.explanation: 글은 팀의 아이디어를 모아서 개선하고, 역할을 나누어 함께 일해 성공했다는 내용이다. 이는 '두 명의 머리는 한 명의 머리보다 낫다'는 의미의 'Two heads are better than one'과 정확히 일치한다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 문맥상 단어의 쓰임이 옳지 않은 것은?

My Best Group Project
My best group project was making a video to ⓐ introduce our school. The name of our group was 'The Stars' and we had four members. First, we wrote a dialogue together. Then, we ⓑ divided up the roles. I ⓒ took the role of reporter. It was difficult for us to set the meeting time. But our video ⓓ turned out to be great! I learned that many heads are ⓔ worse than one.
questions.explanation: 'many heads are worse than one(많은 머리는 한 명보다 더 나쁘다)'은 의미가 맞지 않다. 올바른 표현은 'many heads are better than one(많은 머리는 한 명보다 낫다)'이어야 한다.

How did you do the marshmallow challenge?
Every team does the marshmallow challenge differently. Let's look at some examples. Which one do you like best?
questions.explanation: 글에서 'Let's look at some examples(몇 가지 예시를 살펴보자)'라고 했으므로, 이어질 내용은 마시멜로우 과제가 실제로 수행된 구체적인 사례여야 한다.

options: The Key Point : Group Brainstorming
Successful Teamwork to Complete a Task
How to Choose a Suitable Role in the Team
How to Divide up Roles Effectively
The Factors for Having a Good Friendship
questions.question:
다음 글의 가장 적절한 제목으로 알맞은 것은?

We didn't try to choose the best idea. Instead, we took a good idea and improved on it. One student suggested a triangle shape for the base. We all agreed and divided up the roles such as time checker and tape cutter. We worked together as a team. Finally, we built our tall tower!
questions.explanation: 글은 팀이 아이디어를 개선하고, 역할을 나누어, 함께 일해서 목표(높은 탑)를 성공적으로 완성했다는 내용이다. 따라서 'Successful Teamwork to Complete a Task(작업을 완료하기 위한 성공적인 팀워크)'가 가장 적절한 제목이다.
